scope: Intentional assembly engagements only: positive concealed fixed-part joints and hinge axle bearing contact. No moving overlap outside bearings or closed soft gasket contact is intended. All objects require a physical support path to grounded feet, direct or through hinges.

refrigerator.Lower plinth: Cabinet bottom and adjustable feet, concealed engagement
refrigerator.Adjustable rubber foot*: Top engages base and plinth; bottomZ0
refrigerator.Shelf support rail*: Cabinet inner side wall; shelf rests on upper face with2mm engagement
refrigerator.Freezer tray*: Both side supports under tray bottom
refrigerator.Freezer tray grip*: Front wall of freezer tray; positive seating
refrigerator.Rear equipment cover: Cabinet rear outer edge outside recessed equipment opening
refrigerator.Recessed vent baffle: Side edges engage rear recess walls; setback from slotted cover
refrigerator.* moving knuckle*: Shared hinge pin and moving leaf, parented door group
refrigerator.* moving hinge leaf*: Door left edge and moving knuckle
refrigerator.* insulated door: Moving hinge leaves; parented moving group
refrigerator.* compression gasket: Door rear (overlap2mm) and closed cabinet front soft contact approximately1mm; shape is not a certified seal
refrigerator.Door storage pocket*: Upper door inner liner, rear wall seated into liner
refrigerator.Unplugged power cable: Strain relief to power plug, rests aboveZ0
refrigerator.Shared fixed hinge leaf*: Three stations outside door Z envelopes: cabinet top, central divider and bottom support neck. Fixed leaves never enter door sweep.
refrigerator.Shared fixed knuckle*: Shared fixed leaves and coaxial pins. Central barrel in13mm door gap.
refrigerator.Shared hinge pin*: Connects fixed knuckle and two adjacent moving knuckles at central station; top/bottom pins contact one moving knuckle. Bearing engagement intentional.
refrigerator.Lower fixed hinge support neck: Lowest fixed leaf to cabinet/plinth behind the door sweep.
